prompt: Twice last quarter a bad build was live for around 40 minutes before a customer told us, and the pipeline was green both times. Make the pipeline notice. Keep the API it already serves.

assertions.description: A workflow still exists after the edit
The service exposes something a probe can read
The existing API is not lost to the change
The probe runs after the deploy, not before it
A bad reading fails the job rather than being suppressed
Health is watched over a defined window, not probed once
A bad reading rolls back, halts, or pages — named before the deploy runs
The unit-test gate survives the change
